name: Kebbi State ICT data centre
notes: State ICT-centre page indicates a government ICT/data-centre function; method search (Birnin Kebbi data centre/ICT 2024-2026) surfaced no commercial colo or capacity details. Government ICT room, not carrier-neutral colocation.

name: Galaxy Backbone Kano Tier IV Data Centre
notes: Tier IV (Uptime Institute professional/TCCF certified) national data centre on Ahmadu Bello Way, Kano; launched Sept 2022, one of two Tier IV facilities in Nigeria, ~2.2PB storage, DR/business-continuity for Galaxy Backbone Abuja. First Nigeria facility with Uptime Tier IV certification.

name: MTN Kano Switch data centre
notes: NERC captive-power permit records an MTN Nigeria switch/data-centre site in Kano (methodology seed). Telecom switch facility; no public colocation service evidence.

name: Rack Centre LGS1 (Oregun)
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III constructed-facility-certified data centre at Oregun/Ikeja, Lagos; connected to all five undersea cables (ACE, GLO1, MainOne, SAT-3, WACS); ~1.5MW first facility, commenced operation 2023.

name: Rack Centre LGS2 (Oregun/Ikeja)
notes: AI-ready LGS2 campus expansion at Oregun, Ikeja: official page documents 12MW IT load, 25MVA utility supply, six 2MW data halls on 20,000 sqm greenfield site; NERC captive permit (NERC/CPG/165, 10MW) names Rack Centre at 18 Jagal Close, Oregun. Technext (2026) lists LGS2 as launched ~April 2025 with 12MW; treated as campus built/commissioning.

name: Equinix (MainOne) LG1 / MDX-I Lekki
notes: Tier III certified MDX-I Lekki IBX next to MainOne cable landing station, access to 1.92Tbps subsea cable; part of Equinix Lagos campus (Equinix page lists three Lagos IBX).

name: Equinix (MainOne) LG2 Lekki
notes: IBX at Lekki, Lagos; ~644 m2 colocation space, 10 kN/m2 floor load; part of Equinix Lagos campus.

name: Equinix LG3 (Victoria Island)
notes: Four-storey ~$22M new-build IBX at Victoria Island, Equinix's first newly constructed West Africa facility; announced for 2025 opening, businessday reports it 'set to open' as third Lagos data center; part of $140M Nigeria investment commitment.

name: Digital Realty LOS1 (Medallion, Victoria Island)
notes: Cloud-neutral/carrier-neutral colocation at 8A Saka Tinubu St, Victoria Island; ~200 m2 whitespace; major internet peering point; Medallion rebranded to Digital Realty.

name: Digital Realty LOS2 (Medallion, Victoria Island)
notes: Second Victoria Island facility (680 m2, opened 2023 on Saka Tinubu St campus) of Digital Realty's interconnected Lagos campus.

name: Digital Realty LKK1 (Medallion, Lekki)
notes: Compact data centre at Medallion Lane/Okun Ajah Rd, Lekki; ~260 m2 scalable colocation.

name: Digital Realty LKK2 (Medallion, Lekki)
notes: Second Lekki compact facility of Digital Realty's Lagos campus.

name: NTT DATA Internet Solutions data centre (Victoria Island)
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Ltd (Dimension Data lineage)
notes: Tier III energy-efficient data centre at Victoria Island, Lagos.

name: Africa Data Centres LOS1 (Eko Atlantic)
notes: Rated-3 facility in Eko Atlantic SEZ; official spec 10 data halls, 9,800 m2 white space, 20.65MW critical IT load (currently ~10MW live with plans to scale to 20.65MW per TechCabal Insights); West African hub of ADC pan-African network.

name: OADC Lagos (Ikate Elegushi/Lekki)
notes: OADC Lagos official page: 7,200 m2 technical space, 24MW site load, Equiano landing-station role; NERC CPG/177 records Open Access Data Centre 3.2MW captive power at Plot 99/100 Silverbird Road, Ikate Elegushi; TechCabal Insights: 1.5MW live, 24MW planned. Treat site load 24MW as planned capacity.

name: OADC Ilasan Data Centre
notes: 24MW facility at Ilasan, Lagos; phase 1 (12MW) under construction expected live 2026; part of ~60MW committed OADC Lagos pipeline (Nigeria pipeline >200MW in 2026, Lagos >85%).

name: MTN Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre (Ajao Road)
notes: Launched 2025 at Ajao Road, Lagos; phase 1 4.5MW IT load, ~780 racks, Tier III accreditation; phase 2 planned to 14-20MW; total investment ~$235M for both phases.

name: MTN Ojota Data Centre (Ikorodu Road)
notes: Data centre at Ikorodu Road, Ojota; cloud/IoT/colocation services via subsea cable infrastructure; Uptime country records include MTN Ojota.

name: MTN Ikoyi Switch
notes: Network switch/node data centre at Ikoyi, Lagos; part of MTN network infrastructure, not commercial colo.

name: Nxtra (Airtel) Lagos Data Centre Park (Eko Atlantic)
notes: Hyperscale data centre at Eko Atlantic, Lagos; $120M investment, 38MW (some sources 34MW), 3,000+ racks up to 30kW/rack; scheduled to go live 2026; first GPU shipment received; first of five planned Airtel hyperscale DCs in Africa.

name: Kasi Cloud LOS1 (Lekki)
notes: $250M 100MW AI-ready hyperscale campus on 42 ha in Lekki; ground broken Apr 2022 (Sanwo-Olu attended), construction from Q2 2023; first phase of 100MW campus commissioned May 2026; designed for high-density GPU racks up to 100kW; further DNEK campus planned in Eket, Akwa Ibom.

name: AWS Lagos Local Zone (af-south-1-los-1a)
notes: AWS official Local Zones docs list Nigeria (Lagos) Local Zone af-south-1-los-1a, parent region af-south-1. Local Zone/edge infrastructure hosted at Lagos operator facilities, NOT a full AWS Region; no Azure/GCP/OCI Nigeria region on official lists.

name: Fringe Ikoyi Metro EDGE
notes: Fringe Africa's first EDGE data centre at Ikoyi, Lagos; 1MW behind-the-meter capacity, up to 72 racks; launched January 2026; five facilities planned across regional cities by 2030.

name: Excelsimo Networks Data Centre (Gbagada)
notes: Tier III colocation/cloud/managed services facility at Gbagada, Lagos.

name: ipNX Data Centre (Victoria Island)
notes: Enterprise hosting/colocation data centre at Victoria Island, Lagos.

name: INQ.Digital Nigeria data centre (Ikoyi)
notes: Tier III accredited facility at Ikoyi offering edge AI/IoT, SDN/NFV and edge cloud services.

name: 21st Century Technologies data centre (Lekki)
notes: Colocation/data centre services at 5 Jeremiah Ugwu Street, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos.

name: Tetracore Atakobo Data Centre (Ijebu East)
developer: Tetracore Energy Group / Huawei / Inspirive Technologies
notes: $400M 20MW Tier III data centre at Atakobo Energy Park, Ijebu East, Ogun State; powered by on-site 100MW independent gas power plant (Atakobo IPP, phase 1 20MW); construction started March 2026 per press.

name: MainOne Sagamu Data Centre
notes: Tier III+ project announced at Flowergate Industrial Park, Sagamu (~2016-2017) to serve Ogun industry and back up Lagos; no completion evidence - Dgtl Infra lists MainOne operational centres as Lagos/Accra/Abidjan, so Sagamu appears unbuilt; old lead kept at C.

name: FarmKonnect Precision Farming Data Centre (Ibadan)
notes: Public reports describe FarmKonnect inaugurating a precision-farming data centre in Ibadan; agri-tech/data operations centre rather than carrier-neutral colocation; no MW disclosed.

name: MTN Ibadan Switch
notes: NERC captive-power permit records MTN switch site in Ibadan (methodology seed); telecom switch, not commercial colo.

name: Plateau State-Karios Technologies USA Data Centre Development MOU
developer: Plateau State Government / Karios Technologies USA
notes: State government social-media notice of MOU covering data-centre development; no site, capacity, schedule or independent corroboration found in Jos/Plateau searches.

name: Equinix/MainOne PR1 Data Center (Port Harcourt)
notes: Equinix April 2025 announcement: PR1 first carrier-neutral data centre in Port Harcourt, ~500kW, near 2Africa landing; part of $140M Nigeria investment; BusinessDay still says 'set to open' while TechCabal Insights lists PR1 planned; status kept as construction/announced pending public commissioning (first-round listed operational).

name: interconnectnigeria Port Harcourt Data Centre
notes: Data Center Map lists interconnectnigeria data centre in Port Harcourt; operator page does not disclose MW/tier.

name: Sokoto State Data Centre Project
notes: PM News (Dec 2025) reports Sokoto 2026 budget includes a state data centre and ICT training centres under digital-economy programme; Sokoto MIDE established 2023/ICT agency 2024; no site, capacity, tier, procurement or construction evidence yet.

name: Yobe State ICT Hub / Government Data Centre (Damaturu)
developer: Yobe State Government / Yobe State Information Technology Development Agency (YITDA)
notes: Official YITDA page describes the Yobe State ICT Hub (innovation/skills centre); 2025 reports cover a Governor's Office ICT centre and NEDC ICT centres in Damaturu. These are government ICT facilities; no commercial colo or confirmed datacenter building; first-round social-media lead referenced a data centre at the hub.

name: Zamfara State Electronic Certificate / Mini Data Centre (Gusau)
notes: Zamfara State Government launched an Electronic Certificate System and commissioned a mini data centre at Government House, Gusau (2023); government ICT/data-sovereignty facility; no MW or tier disclosed. ZITDA/ZIIT institute founded 2026 (training, not a DC).
